title: Talking and Working Online
tagline: Email, messaging, and video calls for daily life.
description: Send an email, join a WhatsApp group the right way, and make a video call to family in another town. Simple steps for everyday communication.
outcomes: Create and use an email address
Join and make a video call

lessons.title: Create your email address
lessons.body:
An email address is like a postal address for the internet. Many jobs, schools and government services ask for one.

## Choose a simple address
Use your name, for example chanda.mwale@gmail.com. Avoid nicknames that may look unprofessional to an employer.

## Write it down
Write your email address and password in a safe place at home.
key_points: Use your real name in your address
You need email for jobs and services
lessons.try_it: Write down the email address you would like to create.

lessons.title: Making a video call
lessons.body:
A video call lets you see and hear someone far away. WhatsApp video calls work on most smartphones.

## Before you call
Video uses a lot of data. Use Wi-Fi if you can, or buy a bundle first. Sit somewhere quiet with light on your face.

## Making the call
Open the chat, tap the camera icon at the top. To end, tap the red button.
key_points: Video uses more data than voice
Tap the red button to end
lessons.try_it: Make a two-minute video call to a family member.

lessons.title: Group chat manners
lessons.body:
Group chats are useful for churches, clubs and savings groups. Good manners keep them useful.

## Simple rules
Stay on topic. Do not forward messages you have not checked. Ask before adding someone to a group. Reply privately to one person instead of the whole group.
lessons.try_it: Look at one of your groups. Is there a rule you could share with members?

quiz.question: Before making a video call on mobile data, you should:
quiz.explanation: Video calls use a lot of data, so make sure your bundle is enough or use trusted Wi-Fi.

quiz.question: What is good manners in a group chat?
options: Send many voice notes at night
quiz.explanation: Staying on topic keeps the group useful for everyone.
